lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid. Posterior to the gills, three primary vertical columns are visible, each containing 4-5 discrete high-luminance maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at near-perpendicular angles, forming a structured grid of anchor nodes across the lateral mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp luminance transition from light (dorsal side) to shadow (ventral side), extending from the branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, with approximately 8-12 visible clusters of varying intensity scattered across the macro-mask of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, irregular V-shaped notch or tissue loss is visible at the apex of the leading edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density 'stardust' pattern of micro-scale high-luminance spots, significantly smaller in diameter than the macro-blobs on the lateral flank.
